name: San Remo resolution allocating the Mandate for Syria and Lebanon to France
status_note: Mandate ended 1946 with French troop withdrawal
what_it_did: Allied powers assigned France the mandate for Syria, which included present-day Lebanon.

name: Proclamation of the State of Greater Lebanon
what_it_did: Gouraud declared Greater Lebanon, adding Bekaa, north, south and Beirut to Mount Lebanon.

name: Franco-British Boundary Convention (Palestine-Syria-Lebanon)
what_it_did: Signed in Paris by Hardinge and Leygues; first step to fix mandate boundaries between British and French territories.

name: League of Nations mandate instrument for Syria and the Lebanon
what_it_did: Mandate document written in London 24 July 1922; France formally assigned the mandate 29 September 1923.

name: Paulet-Newcombe Agreement (Franco-British boundary, approved 1923)
status_note: Basis of the present southern border
what_it_did: Fixed the mandate boundaries; today's Israel-Lebanon border is substantially based on it.

name: Lebanese Constitution promulgated
status_note: Amended 1990 after Taif (signed into law 21 Sept 1990)
what_it_did: Turned Greater Lebanon into the Lebanese Republic; institutionalised confessional representation.

name: Franco-Lebanese Treaty of Friendship and Alliance
what_it_did: Would have granted Lebanon conditional independence and 25-year French military presence.

name: National Pact (al-Mithaq al-Watani)
what_it_did: Unwritten 1943 deal: presidency Maronite, premiership Sunni, speakership Shia; 6:5 Christian-Muslim ratio; no union with Syria.

name: Constitutional amendment abolishing mandate provisions
what_it_did: Chamber of Deputies removed mandate-related articles and limited the High Commissioner's powers.

name: Alexandria Protocol
what_it_did: Five Arab states agreed to strengthen relations and coordinate policy, preparing the Arab League.

name: Pact of the League of Arab States
what_it_did: Charter of the Arab League; Lebanon a founding member.

name: UN Charter in force; Lebanon an original UN member
what_it_did: Lebanon signed the UN Charter and joined on 24 October 1945 as an original member.

name: Lebanon joins the IMF
what_it_did: Lebanon became an IMF member on 14 April 1947.

name: Israel-Lebanon General Armistice Agreement (Ras Naqoura)
status_note: No peace treaty followed; line later called Blue Line
what_it_did: Armistice line followed the international boundary; Israel withdrew from 13 occupied Lebanese villages.

name: UNGA Resolution 302 creating UNRWA
what_it_did: Established UNRWA for Palestine refugees, which operates in Lebanon.

name: Dissolution of the Syrian-Lebanese customs union
status_note: Union dissolved March 1950 [Wikipedia dates the break-up of the Syrian-Lebanese economic union to 1948; March 1950 not confirmed]
what_it_did: Ended the common customs and currency arrangement between Lebanon and Syria.

name: Arab League Joint Defence and Economic Cooperation Treaty
what_it_did: Collective defence and economic cooperation pact between Arab League members, Lebanon signatory.

name: Lebanon endorses the Eisenhower Doctrine
what_it_did: Lebanon was the only Arab state to endorse the doctrine openly without reservation.

name: UNSC Resolution 128 (1958): Observer group in Lebanon (UNOGIL)
what_it_did: Created a UN observation group to stop illegal infiltration of personnel or arms across Lebanon's borders.

name: Cairo Agreement
what_it_did: Gave PLO control of Palestinian camps and freedom to operate against Israel from south Lebanon. Signed 2-3 Nov.

name: Melkart Protocol
what_it_did: Tried to curb PLO operations after the May 1973 army-PLO clashes.

name: Constitutional Document (Syrian-brokered reform)
what_it_did: Proposed equal Christian-Muslim representation; early template for Taif parity.

name: Riyadh and Cairo summit agreements creating the Arab Deterrent Force
what_it_did: Arab League legitimised Syrian presence via an expanded peacekeeping force (Arab Deterrent Force).

name: Chtaura Agreement
what_it_did: Tried to restore 1969 Cairo terms and PLO withdrawal from border zones.

name: UNSC Resolution 425 (1978): Israel to withdraw from Lebanon; UNIFIL created
what_it_did: Demanded Israel cease military action and withdraw from Lebanese territory; created UNIFIL to confirm withdrawal and restore Lebanese authority.

name: UNSC Resolution 426 (1978): UNIFIL report and terms of reference
what_it_did: Established UNIFIL for an initial six months, endorsing the Secretary-General's plan for implementing 425.

name: UNSC Resolution 436 (1978): Cessation of fighting in Beirut
what_it_did: Urged all parties to cease hostilities and establish an effective ceasefire; allowed ICRC humanitarian access.

name: Habib ceasefire (Israel-PLO via US)
what_it_did: Oral US-brokered Israel-PLO ceasefire; border calm until June 1982 invasion.

name: UNSC Resolution 508 (1982): Call for cessation of hostilities
what_it_did: Demanded cessation of military activities in Lebanon and across the Lebanese-Israeli border from 0600 on 6 June 1982.

name: UNSC Resolution 509 (1982): Israel to withdraw to the international border
what_it_did: Demanded Israel unconditionally withdraw all forces from Lebanon to the internationally recognised border.

name: UNSC Resolution 512 (1982): Protection of civilians in Lebanon
what_it_did: Called on all parties to respect civilians and facilitate humanitarian aid to Lebanese and Palestinian civilians.

name: Habib plan: PLO evacuation of Beirut
what_it_did: Habib mediated PLO evacuation from Beirut under a multinational force.

name: UNSC Resolution 516 (1982): Ceasefire and UN observers in Beirut
what_it_did: Demanded immediate ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon; authorised UN observers in and around Beirut.

name: UNSC Resolution 517 (1982): Israeli non-compliance, withdrawal demand
what_it_did: Condemned Israel's 3 August advance in Beirut; demanded ceasefire and withdrawal and censured Israeli non-compliance.

name: UNSC Resolution 520 (1982): Withdrawal of Israeli forces from Beirut; Lebanese sovereignty
what_it_did: Condemned Israeli incursions into Beirut violating ceasefires; demanded withdrawal to pre-15 September positions.

name: UNSC Resolution 521 (1982): Condemnation of Sabra and Shatila massacres
what_it_did: Condemned the Sabra and Shatila massacre; raised UN observers in Beirut from ten to fifty.

name: May 17 Agreement (Lebanon-Israel)
status_note: Cabinet cancelled Mar 1984; Parliament revoked 21 May 1987
what_it_did: Would have ended the state of war and set Israeli withdrawal conditional on Syrian withdrawal.

name: Shouf ceasefire (Saudi-US brokered)
what_it_did: Halted Shouf fighting after Israeli pullback; preceded Geneva and Lausanne talks.

name: Lausanne national reconciliation conference
what_it_did: Second round of reconciliation talks after Geneva (Oct-Nov 1983); failed to agree reforms.

name: Tripartite Agreement
status_note: Voided after 15 Jan 1986 coup against Hobeika
what_it_did: Allowed a Syrian peacekeeping presence and committed militias to disband within 12 months.

name: Casablanca Arab summit and Arab Tripartite Committee
what_it_did: Endorsed committee of Saudi, Algeria, Morocco to seek Lebanese settlement.

name: Taif ceasefire
what_it_did: Halted fighting so the Lebanese deputies could meet in Taif.

name: Taif Agreement (National Reconciliation Accord)
what_it_did: Ended civil war; moved powers to cabinet, set 50:50 parity, conditioned militia disarmament.

name: Constitutional amendments implementing Taif
what_it_did: Taif signed into law 21 September 1990: 1:1 parity and reduced presidential powers.

name: General amnesty law for civil-war political crimes
what_it_did: Parliament enacted a general amnesty for political crimes committed during the conflict.

name: Cabinet decision to dissolve militias
what_it_did: Ordered militias disbanded by 30 April 1991 under Taif.

name: Treaty of Brotherhood, Cooperation and Coordination (Lebanon-Syria)
status_note: In force 3 June 1991; later status not stated in text
what_it_did: Created a Supreme Council with binding resolutions and coordination in politics, economy and security.

name: Lebanon-Syria Defence and Security Agreement
status_note: Still formally in force; contested since 2005 [Wikipedia confirms 23 May 1991 Treaty of Brotherhood, Cooperation and Coordination; 1 Sep 1991 Defence and Security Agreement date not confirmed]
what_it_did: Joint defence and security coordination, legal cover for Syrian troops.

name: Madrid Peace Conference (Lebanon participates)
what_it_did: Lebanon joined bilateral talks from 3 Nov 1991; no Israel-Lebanon peace treaty resulted.

name: Lebanon-Syria economic and social cooperation agreements
what_it_did: Package of bilateral accords on trade, labour and transport under the 1991 treaty framework.

name: July Understanding (Israel-Hezbollah, US-brokered)
status_note: Oral, not written; followed by April 1996 understanding
what_it_did: Oral understanding ending Operation Accountability: Israel to spare civilian targets, Hezbollah to stop rocket fire into northern Israel.

name: April Understanding
what_it_did: Barred attacks on civilians and launches from civilian villages; created a five-party monitoring committee.

name: Lebanon a founding member of GAFTA
status_note: Based on 1981 Arab trade facilitation agreement
what_it_did: GAFTA came into being 19 February 1997 with 14 founding members; customs cut 10% a year.

name: WTO accession working party for Lebanon established
what_it_did: WTO set up the working party to negotiate Lebanon's accession terms.

name: Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon completed (UN Blue Line)
status_note: Blue Line is a withdrawal line, not a border
what_it_did: Israel withdrew from Lebanon on 16 June 2000; Res. 1310 extended UNIFIL afterwards.

name: UNSC Resolution 1310 (2000): UNIFIL renewal after Israeli withdrawal
what_it_did: Extended UNIFIL six months to 31 January 2001 after Israel's June 2000 withdrawal.

name: Paris I donor conference
what_it_did: Donors backed Lebanon's debt management with soft loans.

name: Arab Peace Initiative (Beirut summit)
what_it_did: Offered Arab normalisation for full Israeli withdrawal incl. south Lebanon and a just refugee settlement.

name: EU-Lebanon Association Agreement
what_it_did: Euro-Mediterranean pact: phased free trade in industrial goods, political dialogue.

name: Paris II donor conference
what_it_did: Donors pledged $4.4bn in concessional loans, about $3bn to refinance costly debt.

name: UNHCR-Lebanon General Security memorandum of understanding
status_note: Records Lebanon is not an asylum country
what_it_did: Accepted UNHCR status determination on condition recognised refugees are resettled within six months.

name: EFTA-Lebanon Free Trade Agreement
what_it_did: Liberalises trade in industrial goods, fish and processed agriculture; bilateral deals cover basic agriculture.

name: UNSC Resolution 1559 (2004): Sovereignty, Syrian withdrawal, disarmament of militias
status_note: Partly implemented: Syria left 2005; militias remain
what_it_did: Called for Lebanese sovereignty, Syrian withdrawal and disarmament of all militias; supported free presidential elections.

name: UNSC Resolution 1595 (2005): International Hariri assassination investigation
what_it_did: Created the independent commission to investigate the assassination of Rafic Hariri.

name: UNSC Resolution 1636 (2005): Syrian cooperation with Hariri investigation
what_it_did: Demanded Syrian cooperation with the Hariri investigation; travel bans and asset freezes on suspects.

name: UNSC Resolution 1644 (2005): Mehlis report and tribunal of international character
what_it_did: Extended the investigation commission to June 2006 and widened scope to other attacks since October 2004.

name: Hezbollah-FPM Memorandum of Understanding
what_it_did: FPM and Hezbollah signed a memorandum addressing disarmament conditions and Syrian relations.

name: US-Lebanon Trade and Investment Framework Agreement (TIFA)
what_it_did: Framework for trade and investment consultations.

name: National Dialogue conclusions (Palestinian arms, STL)
what_it_did: Agreed to disarm Palestinian groups outside camps and back the Hariri tribunal.

name: UNSC Resolution 1664 (2006): Establishment of tribunal for Lebanon
what_it_did: Asked the Secretary-General to negotiate with Lebanon an international tribunal for the Hariri assassination.

name: UNSC Resolution 1680 (2006): Border delineation and Syria-Lebanon diplomatic ties
what_it_did: Urged Syria to establish diplomatic relations and delineate its border with Lebanon.

name: UNSC Resolution 1686 (2006): Extension of Hariri commission
what_it_did: Extended the Hariri investigation commission's mandate and let it assist on other attacks since October 2004.

name: UNSC Resolution 1701 (2006): Cessation of hostilities, Litani zone, UNIFIL expanded
what_it_did: Called for full cessation of hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah, Israeli withdrawal, militia disarmament and an expanded UNIFIL.

name: 2006 Israel-Hezbollah cessation of hostilities
what_it_did: Halted the 34-day war per 1701; Israeli blockade lifted Sept 2006.

name: Lebanon-Cyprus EEZ delimitation agreement (2007)
what_it_did: First EEZ delimitation deal; never ratified by Lebanon over the unresolved dispute with Israel.

name: Paris III donor conference
what_it_did: Donors pledged about $7.6bn to back Siniora's reform programme after the 2006 war.

name: EU-Lebanon ENP Action Plan
what_it_did: Action plan under the ENP, giving new impetus to bilateral relations.

name: UN-Lebanon agreement on the Special Tribunal for Lebanon
what_it_did: Signed 23 January and 6 February 2007; Parliament did not ratify, so Res. 1757 implemented it.

name: UNSC Resolution 1757 (2007): Establishing the Special Tribunal for Lebanon
what_it_did: Authorised the Special Tribunal for Lebanon; agreement entered into force 10 June 2007.

name: UNSC Resolution 1773 (2007): UNIFIL renewal
what_it_did: Extended UNIFIL one year to 31 August 2008.

name: Arab League Initiative for Lebanon
what_it_did: Three-point plan: elect army chief president, unity cabinet, electoral law.

name: Doha Agreement
status_note: Electoral districts used 2009; unity cabinet dissolved 2011
what_it_did: Ended 18-month crisis: elected Suleiman president, unity cabinet, kaza-based districts.

name: Hezbollah-Israel prisoner exchange
what_it_did: Exchanged Kuntar and four prisoners for the bodies of two Israeli soldiers.

name: Lebanon-Syria diplomatic relations and embassies
what_it_did: Formal diplomatic relations established, the first since both gained independence.

name: Offshore Petroleum Resources Law (Law 132)
what_it_did: Legal framework for offshore licensing and the Petroleum Administration.

name: Decree 6433 defining Lebanon's maritime boundaries
status_note: Line 23 later revised; decree 2022 draft not issued
what_it_did: Filed Lebanon's EEZ coordinates with the UN; basis of talks with Israel.

name: Baabda Declaration (dissociation)
what_it_did: Committed Lebanon to keep out of regional conflicts.

name: Saudi $3bn grant for French arms to Lebanese army
what_it_did: Saudi-funded $3bn programme (Donas) to buy French arms for the Lebanese army.

name: Maarab Understanding (FPM-Lebanese Forces)
what_it_did: Christian reconciliation and deal behind Aoun's 2016 presidency.

name: EU-Lebanon Partnership Priorities and Compact
what_it_did: Linked EU funding for refugees to reforms, jobs and security.

name: Ceasefire and evacuation deal with ISIS at Jroud Arsal
what_it_did: Bus evacuation of ISIS fighters to Deir ez-Zor, ending the border battle.

name: Exploration and Production Agreements for Blocks 4 and 9
what_it_did: First offshore licences: Block 4 dry 2020; Block 9 drilling 2023 found no commercial gas.

name: CEDRE conference (Paris)
what_it_did: Donors pledged $11bn ($10.2bn loans, $860m grants) for Phase I of a $16bn investment programme, tied to reforms.

name: Macron roadmap accepted by Lebanese leaders
what_it_did: Leaders agreed to a reform roadmap after the Beirut port blast.

name: Framework for indirect Israel-Lebanon maritime talks
what_it_did: US-brokered framework opening talks at Naqoura.

name: Reform, Recovery and Reconstruction Framework (3RF)
what_it_did: Platform to direct blast recovery funds through civil society.

name: World Bank ESSN emergency social safety net ($246m)
what_it_did: Emergency cash transfers to about 786,000 people in 147,000 extreme-poor households; builds a national safety-net system.

name: Iraq-Lebanon fuel oil barter agreement
what_it_did: Iraq to supply 1m tonnes of heavy fuel oil over one year, paid in goods and services; signed in Baghdad.

name: Amman meeting to revive Arab Gas Pipeline (Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Lebanon)
what_it_did: Four energy ministers agreed to bring Egyptian gas to Lebanon.

name: Jordan-Lebanon-Syria electricity agreement
what_it_did: Jordan to supply Lebanon 150 MW at night and 250 MW by day over Syrian grid.

name: IMF staff-level agreement on a $3bn EFF (46 months)
status_note: Board approval never reached; prior actions unmet
what_it_did: Staff-level deal on about $3bn, 46-month EFF, subject to eight prior actions incl. bank restructuring and secrecy law.

name: Egypt-Lebanon-Syria gas supply agreements (Arab Gas Pipeline)
status_note: Not implemented: Caesar Act, World Bank terms
what_it_did: Contracts for 22.95 bcf/year of Egyptian gas via Jordan and Syria for 450 MW.

name: Iraq-Lebanon fuel deal extended one year
what_it_did: Iraqi PM approved a one-year extension on the same terms; 1m tonnes, worth about $570m.

name: Israel-Lebanon maritime boundary agreement (US-brokered)
status_note: Exchange of letters; Line 23 adopted; not ratified by Parliament
what_it_did: Fixed the sea boundary at Line 23; Qana development with royalty to Israel. Announced 11 Oct.

name: Iraq-Lebanon fuel deal extended to two million tonnes
what_it_did: Doubled volume and added some crude for swap.

name: World Bank ESSN additional financing ($300m)
what_it_did: Additional $300m for cash assistance to poor households under ESSN.

name: EU EUR 1bn package for Lebanon 2024-27
what_it_did: EUR 1bn for 2024-27: basic services, IMF-requested reforms, army and border management.

name: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire arrangement (Hezbollah-Israel)
what_it_did: 60-day halt; Israel withdraws, Hezbollah north of Litani, army deploys, US-led monitoring panel. Signed 26 Nov.

name: US extension of the ceasefire to 18 February 2025
status_note: Israel kept five positions after 18 Feb
what_it_did: Extended the 60-day withdrawal window by about three weeks.

name: Lebanon-Syria border demarcation and security deal (Jeddah)
status_note: Signed 27 March (ICTJ reports 28 March); committees formed
what_it_did: Defence ministers agreed on legal and security committees to demarcate the roughly 400 km border.

name: Iraq-Lebanon fuel deal extended six months
what_it_did: Iraq agreed on 29 March 2025 to extend fuel supply for six months.

name: World Bank LEAP reconstruction financing ($250m)
what_it_did: $250m for urgent repair of critical infrastructure and rubble management; part of a $1bn scalable framework.

name: UNIFIL renewal summary: 2006-2025, final extension to end-2026
status_note: Ends 31 Dec 2026; withdrawal within one year
what_it_did: Annual renewals 2006-2024; Res. 2790 (2025) final extension, unanimous, then orderly withdrawal.

name: UNSC Resolution 2790 (2025): Final UNIFIL extension to 31 Dec 2026
what_it_did: Unanimous final extension; orderly withdrawal during 2027.

name: Lebanon-Cyprus EEZ delimitation agreement
status_note: Ratified 26 Nov per MEES; some sources say 25 Nov
what_it_did: Delimits the two EEZs; signed at Baabda. Full Lebanese EEZ still needs a deal with Syria.

name: Syria-Jordan gas purchase agreement
status_note: Precursor of the May 2026 trilateral deal
what_it_did: Syria to import about 140 million cubic feet per day of gas from Jordan for power.

name: World Bank $350m for social protection and digital transformation
what_it_did: Financing for social protection and digital transformation.

name: Block 8 exploration and production agreement
what_it_did: TotalEnergies (35%), Eni (35%) and QatarEnergy (30%) entered Block 8; 1,200 km2 3D seismic planned.

name: Qatar aid package for Lebanon (about $420m)
what_it_did: Includes $40m electricity grant, $360m power project, hospital reconstruction, scholarships, $20m for Syrian refugee returns.

name: Lebanon-Syria judicial agreement on transfer of Syrian prisoners
what_it_did: About 300 convicts with 10+ years served to transfer to Syria; all felonies except rape and murder.

name: US-Iran two-week ceasefire
what_it_did: Paused the Iran war; Lebanon inclusion contested.

name: Israel-Lebanon ten-day cessation of hostilities (US-brokered)
what_it_did: Ten-day halt from 16 Apr; both sides stated no war; Israel keeps self-defence.

name: Three-week extension of Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
what_it_did: Announced by Trump after the second Washington round.

name: Egypt-Lebanon contract to restart the Arab Gas Pipeline
what_it_did: Egypt and Lebanon signed a separate contract in May 2026 to restart the gas pipeline initiative.

name: Syria-Jordan-Lebanon gas exchange agreement (energy ministers)
what_it_did: Energy ministers agreed LNG import via Jordan, pumping to Syria, later Lebanon once networks repaired.

name: 45-day extension of Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
what_it_did: Extended truce after the third Washington round.

name: US proposal: Israel spares Beirut suburbs, Hezbollah halts attacks
what_it_did: Mutual-restraint proposal on Dahiyeh and northern Israel.

name: Secretary-General options for a post-UNIFIL presence
what_it_did: Three options: about 1,980, 3,370 or 5,525 personnel; France and Italy float a coalition, EU a training mission.

name: Renewed Israel-Lebanon ceasefire with pilot zones
what_it_did: Set pilot zones for Israeli withdrawal and Lebanese army takeover.

name: US-Iran Islamabad memorandum covering Lebanon front
what_it_did: Interim US-Iran understanding that referenced the Lebanon front.

name: Israel-Hezbollah truce (US, Qatar, Iran mediated)
what_it_did: Trilateral truce announced by Trump.

name: Israel-Lebanon framework agreement (Washington)
what_it_did: Framework: phased Israeli withdrawal, army deployment, Hezbollah disarmament oversight.

name: Lebanon-Syria electricity import contract (under negotiation)
what_it_did: Energy minister Saddi said the contract with Damascus was almost ready; volume not finalised.

name: Lebanon-Syria Joint Higher Committee agreement
what_it_did: Committee to prepare agreements on politics, economy, finance, legal and security issues.

name: Israeli handover of buffer-zone sections to Lebanese control
what_it_did: First pilot-zone transfers under the framework.

name: Israel-Lebanon agreement on disarmament verifier countries
what_it_did: Named countries to verify Hezbollah disarmament and Israeli withdrawal.

name: Prospective IMF staff-level agreement (new)
status_note: Banking restructuring law passed; gap law outstanding
what_it_did: Lebanon seeks a new staff-level agreement, possibly by year-end; financial gap law still needed.

name: EU EUR 505m tranche for Lebanon 2026-27
status_note: Second tranche of the EUR 1bn package
what_it_did: Second tranche of the EUR 1bn package for 2026-27: services, recovery, border management, civil society.
